decision: Retain the allocation as an inactive research candidate. All 252 snapshots and 720 direction/cap probes have sufficient visible depth; all current size/leverage metadata qualify. The sample does not establish historical or future fills, repair higher historical drawdown, or resolve weaker later full-fee results. Prepare an exact inactive allocation and separately frozen prospective comparison contract before any live proposal.
falsifier: Changed metadata, fee mode, book depth, failed raw/normalized parity, source tampering or independent arithmetic/replay disagreement updates the snapshot-capacity claim. Future liquidity, production fills, stop behavior and returns need separately observed evidence.
hypothesis: The fixed equal-route-cap allocation can be evaluated for current size precision, visible entry/close depth and fee costs without changing routes or observing strategy performance.
limitations: Correlated six-minute public snapshots; no strategy replay, actual fills or profitability prediction.
Opposing entry and close walks use the same snapshot, not a future liquidation or stop path.
Full returned depth only; no price limit, queue, cancellation, funding, or production latency simulation.
Fee rates are current unsigned evidence with no aligned collateral discount; future/historical fees remain unverified.
Additional 2.5/5.5 bps per side is separate stress and can overlap visible book impact.
All sample observations are correlated; high confidence applies to source/accounting parity, low confidence to future liquidity or profitability.
The six-minute quote study preserves the September 8–22 sealed prospective experiment and contains no strategy outcomes.
No live configuration, process lifecycle or TUI changed. The 18:14 tracked process/config check does not refresh the 14:11 account snapshot.
Current capacity at larger quantity cannot validate the historical quantity-linear fixed-fill assumption.

independent_audit.scope: Every probe, including every cell worst-capacity observation; original/equal cap rounding, both depth walks, fees and friction.
